data.description: Falcon City of Wonders, also known as FalconCity, is a 100 acre (405 thousand square meter) development being built within Dubailand. The project is a multi faceted residential, tourist and entertainment.

data.answer:
Falcon City of Wonders boasts more than 20 distinct sub-communities. Its amenities cater comprehensively to its residents and visitors alike. These include a vibrant mall offering retail options, offices for business activities, hotels for accommodation needs, and educational institutes providing learning opportunities within the community.

There are also lots of green spaces where you can enjoy strolls. The project’s focus on sustainability and smart living enhances its appeal to modern buyers who value eco-friendly and technologically advanced living spaces.

Falcon City of Wonders Master Plan

Falcon City of Wonders is characterized by its distinctive architectural themes, comprising Andalusia, Aegean, New World, and Santa Fe. Andalusia showcases detached villas inspired by the grandeur of Spanish architecture from the Andalusian era. Meanwhile, Aegean offers Greek-style 4-bedroom townhouses and a variety of villas ranging from 3 to 5 bedrooms. New World introduces townhouses influenced by North American design, while Santa Fe presents Mexican-style detached villas.

Among the internationally themed sub-communities within Falcon City of Wonders are Western Residence North, Western Residence South, and Eastern Residences Villas (North and South). Each of these sub-communities offers unique residential experiences:

Located in phase 2 development, Western Residence North encompasses 214 residential units situated adjacent to Pyramid’s Park.

Developed in the first phase, Western Residence South occupies the southern part of the development’s western wing, featuring 215 villas and 131 townhouses.

Eastern Residences Villas is an upcoming project offering spacious 5 to 6-bedroom houses, Eastern Residences Villas are designed with private roof terraces, expansive floor plans with separate kitchens and pantries, large bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, efficient ventilation systems, autonomous TV, internet, and air-conditioning controls, built-in wardrobes, shaded parking for three cars, and backyard swimming pools. These residences are designed to provide luxurious and comfortable living environments within Falcon City of Wonders.

Noteworthy features of Falcon City of Wonders include its diverse residential offerings, representing over 25 countries. The development is structured around four thematic housing zones, each designed to reflect unique architectural styles and cultural influences. Residential options within Falcon City of Wonders encompass villas ranging from 3 to 5 bedrooms, alongside townhouses available in 3 and 4-bedroom configurations.

The architectural design of the residences reflects a fusion of traditional Arabic and contemporary styles, ensuring that each home is aesthetically pleasing and functional. 

Buying a Property in Falcon City of Wonders

Looking for properties for sale in Dubai? Falcon City of Wonders stands out as a prime destination in Dubailand for property investment. For families or investors contemplating purchasing homes in this vibrant community, the following estimates provide valuable insights:

  • Demand for villas in Falcon City of Wonders starts from AED 2.2 million.
  • Freehold townhouses in Falcon City of Wonders are priced between AED 2.6 million and AED 3.5 million.
  • The starting price for 3-bedroom villas for sale is AED 2.4 million, while 4-bedroom villas range up to AED 6 million. Similarly, 5-bedroom villas are priced between AED 2.29 million and AED 6.2 million.

Compared to general trends in Dubai's freehold real estate market, property prices in Falcon City of Wonders are currently affordable. However, these prices are expected to rise as the development reaches completion. Currently, prospective buyers can acquire 3-bedroom townhouses in Falcon City of Wonders for between AED 2 million and AED 2.7 million. Meanwhile, 4-bedroom townhouses in the development are priced from AED 2.6 million to AED 2.9 million.

Rental Properties in Falcon City of Wonders

Prospective renters seeking premier locations in Dubailand have a diverse selection of villas available in Falcon City of Wonders. Rental rates for 3-bedroom and 4-bedroom houses for rent in Falcon City of Wonders Dubai, UAE, range from AED 120,000 to AED 135,000 per year. As development progresses, more rental villas are expected to become available within Falcon City of Wonders, offering expanded options for residents.

Life in Falcon City of Wonders

Life in Falcon City of Wonders offers a blend of luxury, convenience, and cultural richness within its meticulously designed community. Residents experience a unique living environment surrounded by architectural wonders inspired by global landmarks. 

The community features a range of residential options from spacious villas to stylish townhouses, catering to diverse lifestyle preferences. With landscaped parks, recreational facilities, and integrated amenities such as shopping centers and schools, Falcon City of Wonders ensures a vibrant and family-friendly atmosphere. Its strategic location in Dubai provides easy access to major highways and key destinations across the city, enhancing connectivity for residents.

Public Transportation in Falcon City of Wonders

Public transportation options in Falcon City of Wonders are designed to enhance accessibility for residents and visitors. The development is well-connected by Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), allowing convenient access to Dubai's public bus services and taxi facilities. 

Buses are the primary mode of public transportation near Falcon City of Wonders. Within the development, a centrally located bus stop near the main entrance serves as a key transit point. Bus lines such as 103 and F30 stop at this station.

Supermarkets Near Falcon City of Wonders

Falcon City of Wonders offers residents convenient access to various supermarkets in the nearby community, Dubai Silicon Oasis, like Al Madina Mart, Al Maya Supermarket, and Grandiose Supermarket. These supermarkets cater to daily grocery needs, providing a wide selection of fresh produce, household essentials, and speciality items.

Shopping Malls Near Falcon City of Wonders Area

Near Falcon City of Wonders, residents can easily access several shopping malls within a short driving distance. Prominent options include Dubai Silicon Oasis Mall, located approximately 10 minutes away, offering a range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities. 

Moreover, the Arabian Ranches Souk is within a 15-minute drive, providing a charming shopping experience with boutique shops, cafes, and essential services. These nearby malls ensure that residents of Falcon City of Wonders have convenient access to diverse shopping and leisure amenities, enhancing their overall living experience.

Schools and Nurseries Near Falcon City of Wonders

Near Falcon City of Wonders, residents benefit from convenient access to a variety of schools and nurseries within a short driving distance. Prominent educational institutions nearby include GEMS New Millennium School - Al Khail and GEMS United School - Dubailand, both located approximately 10 minutes away by car.

Also, Ranches Primary School and Jumeirah English Speaking School (JESS) Arabian Ranches are within a 15-minute drive, providing diverse educational options catering to different curricula and learning needs. For families with young children, there are well-equipped nurseries in nearby communities, ensuring comprehensive early childhood education and care services. These educational facilities contribute to the appeal of Falcon City of Wonders as a family-friendly residential destination, offering convenient access to quality education close to home.

Places of Worship Near Falcon City of Wonders

Residents of Falcon City of Wonders have access to various places of worship within close proximity. Nearby, there are churches, temples, and mosques that cater to the spiritual needs of the community. 

Examples include St. Mary's Catholic Church in Dubai Silicon Oasis, which is approximately a 10-minute drive away, and the Sri Shirdi Sai Baba Mandir in Dubai Investment Park, accessible within a 15-minute drive. Mosques such as the Falconcity Mosque within the development itself and others nearby ensure residents can practice their faith conveniently, fostering a diverse and inclusive community environment.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Falcon City of Wonders Area

Residents of Falcon City of Wonders have access to a range of healthcare facilities, including clinics and hospitals, in the surrounding areas. Nearby clinics include Aster Clinic in Dubai Silicon Oasis, approximately a 10-minute drive away, and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital in Dubai Silicon Oasis, accessible within a similar timeframe. 

For specialized medical care, hospitals like NMC Royal Hospital in Dubai Investment Park and Emirates Hospital Day Surgery & Medical Center in Motor City are within a 15 to 20-minute drive from Falcon City of Wonders. These healthcare facilities ensure residents have convenient access to medical services and emergency care, enhancing the community's appeal as a well-rounded residential destination.

Falcon City of Wonders Location & Nearby Areas

Falcon City of Wonders is strategically located in Dubailand, offering residents easy access to key areas across Dubai. Situated near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), the development enjoys seamless connectivity to major highways, facilitating convenient travel to Dubai's central business districts, entertainment hubs, and airports. 

Nearby areas include Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai Academic City, and Dubai Motor City, each offering their unique amenities and attractions. This prime location ensures that residents of Falcon City of Wonders can enjoy a well-connected lifestyle while being surrounded by green spaces and iconic architectural landmarks.

more_info.question: FAQs About Falcon City of Wonders

data.answer:
Who is the owner of Falcon City?

The owner of Falcon City of Wonders is Falconcity of Wonders LLC, a private company founded by Salem Ahmad AlMoosa Enterprises.

What is the master plan of Falcon City of Wonders?

The master plan of Falcon City of Wonders includes themed residential areas inspired by global architectural wonders, integrated amenities such as parks, schools, and retail spaces, and a focus on creating a unique living environment with cultural and recreational elements.

How big is Falcon City?

Falcon City of Wonders spans over a substantial area, covering approximately 41 million square feet.

What transport is available in Falcon City of Wonders? 

Public buses, taxis, and ride-sharing services are available for transportation in Falcon City of Wonders.

What are the most popular restaurants in Falcon City of Wonders? 

Popular restaurants include Shakespeare and Co., Al Safadi, and Mandi House.

What clinics and hospitals are in Falcon City of Wonders? 

Nearby clinics include Aster Clinic and Mediclinic, with larger hospitals like Mediclinic Parkview Hospital located within a short drive.

Which schools and kindergartens to choose in Falcon City of Wonders? 

Popular options include GEMS Winchester School and The Indian International School for primary and secondary education.

How to get from Falcon City of Wonders to famous attractions? 

You can reach famous attractions like The Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa by driving or taking a taxi, approximately 20 minutes away.

data.content:
Falcon City of Wonders is a mixed-use development located in Dubai. This mega project is designed to resemble a falcon, a symbol of the UAE's heritage. It was launched in 2005 by Falconcity of Wonders, a private company established by Salem Ahmad AlMoosa Enterprises.

It is divided into wings that host replicas of international wonders such as the Eiffel Tower, Taj Mahal, and the Pyramids of Giza. The development offers a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, catering to a diverse community of residents and visitors.

Falcon City of Wonders offers various residential options, from spacious villas and townhouses to modern apartments. With its unique concept, prime location, and comprehensive amenities, Falcon City of Wonders is set to be a landmark development that defines luxury living in Dubai.

nodes.title: Sakura Gardens
nodes.about:
Sakura Gardens at Falcon City of Wonders is a resort-style community inspired by Japanese design, promoting harmony and timeless elegance. Comprising four 9-storey towers, the development offers fully furnished studio, 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments, along with 2, 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses. These smart homes can be secured with just a 10% down payment.

Sakura Gardens by HRE Development seamlessly blends nature, architecture, and wellbeing. Residents enjoy essential amenities including swimming pools, a leisure deck, gyms, a wellness pavilion, and a clubhouse. The combination of a resort-inspired setting and sustainable features enhances its appeal as a strong investment opportunity with promising ROI.
